description: The Hyperliquid coins with market data, largest open interest first: mark price, open interest and 24h volume in USD, funding (APR), maximum leverage and the number of tracked positions. Use it to find the exact coin name (BTC, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA) before calling another tool, or for the largest markets.

coin.description: Only this coin (case-insensitive), e.g. to check that a name exists.

limit.description: Number of coins, by open interest (default 25, at most 200).

name: list_coins

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

title: Coin list
